I implemented everything in `minidb/expr_eval.py`, and all 25 tests in `tests/test_expr_eval.py` pass. I didn't run the integration tests.

I added one private helper, `_check`, which raises `TypeMismatchError` for any operand that isn't a bool or NULL. `logical_not`, `logical_and`, `logical_or` and `where_matches` all use it.

I made no changes to `tests/test_expr_eval.py`.
